candidate: Bombina variegata dynamic pond metapopulations, Aargau Switzerland, 1999–2019

scientific_anchor.focal_selection_reason: prospectively chosen conservation-target species: target-species monitoring comprehensively surveys all potentially suitable breeding sites in surveyed subregions; Bombina variegata is one of the more mobile target species and has a substantial documented Aargau breeding-site network. Common species are not chosen because their potential sites were not all visited.
scientific_anchor.published_site_dynamics: 469 existing sites in 1999, 780 in 2019; 422 sites newly constructed since 1991 and 76 sites destroyed; site existence is modeled separately from species occupancy
scientific_anchor.survey_semantics: target-species breeding sites are surveyed comprehensively in a rotating subregion panel; repeat visits within surveyed breeding seasons provide detection/nondetection histories
scientific_anchor.process_boundary: the five major river-valley regions are treated by the source study as distinct metapopulations, potentially connected within regions but relatively isolated between regions. EOG will not invent cross-region edges; source/process closure must be certified within each retained region before outcome access.

observation_response.role: FORBIDDEN until complete prospective outcome authorization

potential_population_connectivity.role: response-derived occupied-neighbor connectivity; FORBIDDEN before response authorization except metadata identity

metadata_resolution.note: generic role matcher overmatched descriptions, but exact CKAN IDs/names were frozen before any ecological response resource was opened

completed_static_schema_audit.model_code_structural_connectivity_defin: five response-independent scalar summaries only: nearest-neighbor distance, pond density within 1 km^2, and kernel connectivity at alpha 200/500/1000 m
completed_static_schema_audit.model_code_population_connectivity_defin: analogous occupied-neighbor summaries; response-derived and still forbidden

final_response_blind_geometry_audit.purpose: airtight final check whether either remaining response-independent CSV contains complete coordinates, source-target pair rows, pairwise distances or another full spatial representation not visible in metadata/model code
final_response_blind_geometry_audit.expected_static_site_order_reference: the 856 SiteID values in frozen covariate_static; the final audit may verify schemas/counts only and must not use species observations to subset nodes
final_response_blind_geometry_audit.acceptance_rule: continue only if a complete response-independent raw/masked coordinate registry or complete pairwise distance/network representation exists for an auditable node universe; per-site scalar connectivity summaries alone fail

future_geometry_boundary.spatial_requirement: a complete response-independent site coordinate registry or a complete pairwise distance/network representation for the chosen analysis nodes must be available as physical public bytes; precomputed scalar connectivity summaries alone are insufficient
future_geometry_boundary.region_rule: if geometry passes, build worlds separately within response-independently declared geographic regions; do not select regions by the source model's >10-detections rule and do not add cross-region edges

future_endpoint_boundary.provisional_endpoint: one-survey-primary-period-ahead Bombina variegata occupancy/detection state, conditional on independently observed site existence and survey availability; exact observation rule and split are frozen from documentation/code before observation rows are opened
future_endpoint_boundary.learner_boundary: same frozen strong random forest and same conventional predictors in both arms; augmented arm adds only unchanged symmetric_world_support_summary_v1
